summary: Builds a full file path for a track-style file: extracts the basename from the input path, assembles two extension suffix strings from file-extension globals (0x005C71C0/0x005C71C4/0x005C71C8 and 0x005C7190/0x005C7194/0x005C7196), strips trailing backslashes from the working copy in byte_7CD718, resolves it through sub_497AD0, copies either the resolved path or the default directory fallback byte_5EA438 into the caller buffer, then hands the assembled path to sub_479170 for further parsing.

local_names.v15: local extension-suffix buffer for track extension globals
local_names.v16: local extension-suffix buffer for file extension globals

operations.description: Null input path guard: when a2 is null the function returns immediately via SingleCallWrapper_8e80 with argument 0
Basename extraction: walk a2 backward from its end to the last backslash character and treat everything after it as the basename start v3
Copy the basename into local buffer v15 (16 bytes) with sub_587DD0, terminate it, then append track-extension bytes read from globals 0x005C71C0, 0x005C71C4 and 0x005C71C8
Copy the same basename into local buffer v16 (16 bytes) with sub_587DD0, terminate it, then append file-extension bytes read from globals 0x005C7190, 0x005C7194 and 0x005C7196
Copy the input path a2 into the working buffer byte_7CD718 (up to 255 bytes) with sub_587DD0 and write the null terminator flag byte_7CD817 = 0
Trailing-backslash strip loop over byte_7CD718: overwrite characters with 0 walking backward until a backslash is found or the start of the buffer is reached
Assemble the full path: copy the stripped path into local buffer v17 (256 bytes) with sub_587DD0, strcat the v15 extension suffix onto byte_7CD718, and strcat the v16 extension suffix onto v17
Copy the assembled working path byte_7CD718 into the resolved-path global unk_7CD618 (up to 255 bytes) with sub_587DD0 and write the copy flag byte_7CD717 = 0
Resolve the path: sub_497AD0(byte_7CD718, 0) produces the resolved path, and its result is wrapped by SingleCallWrapper_8e80

Copy the outcome back to the caller: on a non-zero resolution result StringCopyWithBufferRealloc copies the resolved path into a2, otherwise it copies the default application-directory fallback byte_5EA438
Parse/use the assembled path: return sub_479170(this, v17), passing the local assembled path buffer to the downstream parser
